defaultPrompt: Use BeyondSEO to audit my website with evidence, coverage limits, priorities and acceptance checks.
Use BeyondSEO to create a grounded SEO, AEO and GEO content plan for my business.
Use BeyondSEO to assess competitors and backlink/reputation opportunities without inventing evidence.
interface.longDescription: Use BeyondSEO-inspired workflows to audit websites, interpret crawl evidence, plan content and competitors, assess reputation and backlinks, and verify authorised improvements. Native crawling requires the source package and a permitted Python/browser runtime; this plugin does not bundle or run the repository's crawler engine.

name: beyondseo
description: Evidence-led website SEO audits, content strategy, competitor research, reputation analysis, and authorised improvement planning based on BeyondSEO.
